metadata.title: Elia Tolin — Computer Scientist
metadata.description: Born in 1999. Started coding at 16, founded my first startup at 17. Today around 234,000 people use software I wrote.

hero.title: computer scientist & independent consultant
hero.headlineStart: I turn problems I've had into
hero.roles: Head of Tech at <bd>Builtdifferent</bd>, founder of <au>Aurora Digital</au>, co-founder and CTO of <er>Ermanno</er>, and founder of <fm>Flutter Modena</fm>.
hero.flagNote: — across my own products and platforms built for companies.

steps.title: 1999 — Sanremo, Italy
steps.text: I grew up between the Ligurian coast and the hills of Reggio Emilia, building bows and contraptions. Making things beat watching things.

steps.title: At 16 I found programming
steps.text: At a technical school in Sassuolo. I never stopped.

steps.title: At 17, my first startup
steps.text: A platform for lost-and-found items. Cold emails and phone calls took me all the way to the City of Milan — it was bigger than me and it died there. The lesson didn't: if you write to everyone, someone answers.

steps.title: At 20 I joined Modula SpA
steps.text: A world leader in vertical automated warehouses. In R&D I was the only one without a degree: industrial automation in C++ and C#, computer vision, porting an entire system to Linux. Meanwhile I paid my own way through university — seven years, working full time.

steps.title: 2021 — Status Vaccini
steps.text: In 2021 I built Status Vaccini, Italy's first app for tracking the Covid vaccination campaign. Open source, built with Flutter.

steps.title: 2022 — Aurora Digital is born
steps.text: Nine months after Status Vaccini I registered as self-employed and founded Aurora Digital — still an employee, still a student. A year later I left my job: since then I've worked with companies as a developer and consultant.

link.label: See what I do with Aurora Digital →

steps.title: That same year I founded Flutter Modena
steps.celebration: Today it's the most active Flutter community in Italy 🎉

steps.title: Since 2023 — Head of Tech at Builtdifferent
steps.text: A fitness and nutrition coaching platform with over 50,000 monthly active users.

steps.title: Today I build my own products and work with companies
steps.text: My products are born from problems I had: the app I needed didn't exist, so I wrote it. Through Aurora Digital I work with companies every day as a developer and consultant, while leading the tech at Ermanno, a logistics startup.
steps.celebration: Around 234,000 people use software I wrote 🎉

items.name: Builtdifferent
items.text: Fitness and nutrition coaching built by certified professionals, not algorithms. I lead the platform's technology.

items.name: Ermanno
items.text: Shipments dispatch themselves: from raw transport documents to trucks, couriers and one live dashboard.

items.name: Aurora Digital
items.text: My consulting practice: custom software development and AI training for company dev teams.

items.name: Quiz Radioamatori
items.text: The ham-radio exam app that didn't exist in the stores: I wrote it while studying for the exam myself.

items.name: HamQRG
items.text: Every radio repeater around you, anywhere in the world. Free, with an optional Pro tier.

items.name: Tepio
items.text: Preps your cold calls with an AI brief for every conversation. The Ermanno team uses it daily.

items.name: ZTL Elettrica
items.text: Italy's limited-traffic zones and EV parking perks, city by city, on a single map. Free.

items.name: Acetaia
items.text: Balsamic vinegar barrels used to be managed on Excel or paper. Not anymore.

openSource.title: What I give back
openSource.body: I maintain remote_caching, a Flutter package that ended up cited in the official Flutter documentation, and Supawho, an open-source tool for managing multiple Supabase accounts — born, like everything I build, from a problem I had myself. And I lead Flutter Modena, the most active Flutter community in Italy.

business.title: Work with me
business.intro: Through Aurora Digital I've been working with companies since 2022. Two things, done well:

dev.title: Custom software development
dev.text: Mobile apps in Flutter, web platforms on Next.js and Supabase, firmware on ESP32 and STM32. I cover the whole stack:
dev.highlight: from the firmware on the microcontroller to the app under the user's finger.

training.title: AI training for companies
training.text: I help teams bring AI into the way they work: generative-AI foundations, method, and hands-on labs on the company's real cases. Tailored formats, on site or remote.

business.sectors: I've built management systems for the waste sector, firmware for home appliances, smart-city platforms, logistics software, fitness apps, e-commerce and manufacturing. I work from Emilia-Romagna: on site with companies in the area, remote across Italy.
